title: CephFS目录分片与子树分配分别影响什么？
answer: 目录分片可分散大目录内部元数据，子树分配在MDS间分布命名空间工作。按热点目录操作和MDS负载验收，不能仅增加MDS数量。
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Ceph Squid 官方文档核对
review_note: 会话07作者候选；真实原生验证待运行；独审与正式cephfs白名单待10，不计完成。
body:
## 操作任务
补全place_dirs(fs,global_root,hot,cold)：在2 active MDS的真实CephFS中对含512条目的hot目录执行原生dirfrag split，cold目录实际迁移到rank1。使用支持的dir.pin及MDS命令，轮询真实dirfrag ls与get subtrees，返回fragments/subtrees原样结果和两个rank。教师核真正碎片、权威子树、目录完整和跨目录rename，不接受仅写pin或只增加MDS数量。

保留原题知识：目录分片可分散大目录内部元数据，子树分配在MDS间分布命名空间工作。按热点目录操作和MDS负载验收，不能仅增加MDS数量。

## 提交产物
task.py。

## 验收方法
真实MON/MGR/3 memstore OSD/active与standby MDS、libcephfs；独立客户端核验元数据、数据和清理。

## 能力边界
单机回环隔离有限负载，不证明生产硬件性能、生产容量或Cephx。025公共白名单尚缺cephfs，作者仅用显式进程内单常量提案验证，正式集成阻塞待10。
rubric: 准确解释题设机制与前提
提供对应证据、验收结果及必要风险边界

exercise.environment: Linux UID1000; explicit WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022 student; private Ceph19.2.3
exercise.validation_scope: real private libcephfs/MDS bounded synthetic namespace; no production performance claim

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,json,secrets
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'),str(pathlib.Path.cwd())]
from cephfs_native import PrivateCephFS,native_write,native_read,native_listdir,native_trace
from cephfs_native import native_exists
import task

def canonical(v):return json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),allow_nan=False)
with PrivateCephFS(active_ranks=2)as c:
    hot='/hot-'+secrets.token_hex(3);cold='/cold-'+secrets.token_hex(3);c.fs.mkdir(hot,0o750);c.fs.mkdir(cold,0o750)
    names=['item-'+str(i)for i in range(512)]
    for name in names:native_write(c.fs,hot+'/'+name,name.encode())
    native_write(c.fs,cold+'/known',b'cold-subtree-content')
    receipts=[]
    class RealFS:
        def __getattr__(self,key):return getattr(c.fs,key)
        def mds_command(self,rank,command,*args,**kwargs):
            result=c.fs.mds_command(rank,command,*args,**kwargs);receipts.append((rank,json.loads(command),result))
            native_trace({'kind':'real_libcephfs_mds_command','rank':rank,'request':json.loads(command),'rc':result[0],'stdout':result[1].decode(),'stderr':str(result[2])});return result
    actual=task.place_dirs(RealFS(),c.subvolume,hot,cold)
    for field,prefix,rank in [('fragments','dirfrag ls','0'),('subtrees','get subtrees','1')]:
        assert any(r==rank and req.get('prefix')==prefix and result[0]==0 and canonical(json.loads(result[1]))==canonical(actual[field])for r,req,result in receipts),'returned layout was not a real native response'
    fragments=c.mds_admin('a','dirfrag','ls',c.subvolume+hot);subtrees=c.mds_admin('b','get','subtrees')
    assert len(fragments)>=2 and all(type(x['bits'])is int and x['bits']>=1 for x in fragments),'hot directory not actually fragmented'
    assert any(x['is_auth']and x['auth_first']==1 and x['dir']['path'].lstrip('/')==(c.subvolume+cold).lstrip('/')for x in subtrees),'cold subtree not actually authoritative on rank1'
    assert c.fs.getxattr(hot,'ceph.dir.pin')==b'0'and c.fs.getxattr(cold,'ceph.dir.pin')==b'1'
    assert type(actual['fragment_rank'])is int and actual['fragment_rank']==0 and type(actual['subtree_rank'])is int and actual['subtree_rank']==1
    observed_names=native_listdir(c.observer,hot)
    assert observed_names==sorted(names),'complete hot directory namespace differs'
    for name in observed_names:assert native_read(c.observer,hot+'/'+name)==name.encode(),'hot directory payload differs after layout: '+name
    assert native_read(c.observer,cold+'/known')==b'cold-subtree-content'
    c.fs.rename(hot+'/item-0',cold+'/moved');assert not native_exists(c.observer,hot+'/item-0')and native_read(c.observer,cold+'/moved')==b'item-0'
    native_trace({'kind':'real_cephfs_fragment_and_subtree','fragments':fragments,'subtrees':subtrees,'files':len(names),'cross_directory_rename':True})
    print('NATIVE_DIRFRAGS_SUBTREE_AND_RENAME_PASSED',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED')
